steps.name: The Kali Tribe's Trust (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in "Kali", then obtain <Tam's Magic Stone>, a <Powerful Brainwashing Magic Stone>, and a <Disillusionment Magic Stone>. Deliver them to [Medea] in "Kali".

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You've come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said I should visit often if I wanted to earn your trust.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, I did. What shall we discuss? Naturally, what you seek.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The power needed for Goddess Iris to become the world's true master...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For Iris's sake, I need a trace of your power. The Champions' strength helps her...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Doesn't it seem strange that the power of a mere human like me would help a goddess? Human and divine power are different.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yet the goddess receives it and immediately gains another ability...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that you mention it, it does seem a little strange. Even if she receives a Champion's power through me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Champions are human, and so am I... But Iris is in the realm of gods. Ugh, it's complicated.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There must have been many things to question, yet you harbor no doubts about Goddess Iris.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A subtle relationship, but an enviable one. Shall we get to the point?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Bring me magic stones.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What kind?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ultimately, stones made by the Deimos cult from the power gained by hunting our people.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You won't find those without going to Avalon. Even there, you wouldn't know where to look...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I can only guess they're running low. Their incursions into Adrica have become more frequent...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's why you hid the village. To protect it...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We've lived that way for a long time. I want to use the stones to learn what they are so obsessed with.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Bring stones from places where their traces were found: a 'Stone of Greed,' a 'Powerful Brainwashing Stone,' and a 'Stone of Disillusionment.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Magic stones found in Jiendia, Freios, and Eastland...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll get them. But... When this is done, will I have earned your trust?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll consider you more favorably than before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. If you need them, I'll bring them. I'll look for other clues, too. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: May your journey be uneventful.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You've come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I brought the stones you asked for. Here...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Would you wait here a moment?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll serve tea so you won't be bored while waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It smells lovely. What's it called?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's brewed from the leaves of a tree called daphne, found only in the Land of Illusions. Daphne was also the name of our previous leader, who was like a mother to me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I remember her as a wonderful person. Yet in someone's lingering memories, she's called a witch who reveled in Walpurgis Night...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To think I'd tell you even that. Pretend you didn't hear it. You truly are a strange person...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah, please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Walpurgis Night, though...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora told me not to get involved in that...)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It wasn't difficult to identify the traits of the stones you brought.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: One of the three, from the Hall of Heroes, seems to be the Deimos cult's work. It held a faint trace of our people's life force.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is the cult trying to do...?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We've investigated for over two hundred years, but no one has found the answer.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now, the other two. They clearly bear traces of those called Agasuras, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong? Is there a problem?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: They're imitations of the cult's stones. Skillfully made, but far short of the originals.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic called Ban and Mara false Agasuras. Is that related?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I've rarely encountered Agasuras. I can't answer that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Imitations, yet they devastated Jiendia and Freios... Then the cult's stones are even more dangerous...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...That's all I have to say. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She seems to know more, but she's cutting me off...)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And thank you for the book you obtained at Layer's request. It let me briefly understand the goddess's feelings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You read it? Who brought it to you?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Tartaros sent a large shipment, seeking renewed relations. Beinan wanted to send it back, but I couldn't bring myself to refuse, so I accepted it for now.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you're returning, give my regards to Layer for his efforts. Tell him I'm well, and that his choice was right.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And give Noel a message, too.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Because of the danger from the Deimos cult, she should stay within Lumen, where Ziskad is, and Tartaros, where Shynic is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll tell them everything. See you again.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: (Perhaps you'll need to visit once more...)

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: You look tired. Keeping busy? Where have you come from?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kali.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: (Layer seems too surprised to continue.)

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Of course. You're no ordinary person. Finding the elusive village of Kali... Just what I'd expect of the goddess's chosen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea asked me to give you her regards.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: What did she say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That she's well, and your choice was right.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Ahahaha. That's Medea for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What choice did she mean?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: An embarrassing past. Hmm...

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Thirty years ago, before I met Medea, I was consumed by anger. If I couldn't kill everyone, I wanted to kill at least one person...

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I was returning to Jude after a job. Then, as I told you before, I ended up in Kali.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: During my brief stay, Medea helped me change my mind.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I won't tell you whom I wanted to kill, so don't pry. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I won't.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: (As soon as he finishes speaking, Layer takes a carrot from the warehouse and starts waving it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Layer, why are you suddenly waving a carrot?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: ...Oh, you noticed. Should I explain or not...?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Ah, whatever. Noel told me that if anyone mentioned visiting Kali, I should discreetly wave a carrot. She must have needed time to prepare.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I was supposed to be subtle. Apparently, I made it too obvious. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Yes, very obvious. Medea has a message for Noel, too.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Good. Noel will be waiting. Oh, I'll treat you next time. Look forward to it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Great! Let me know when. I'll go see Noel now.

steps.name: The Kali Tribe's Trust (4)
steps.objective: Obtain <Dwarf Craftsman's Nuts and Bolts> and a <Dwarf Craftsman's All-Purpose Toolbox> aboard the "Dwarf Airship". Then find [Merimel] in "Kali".

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: (Flustered, Noel quickly looks away.)

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Oh, right. What a wonderful adventurer! Won't you buy something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you see the carrot?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Of carrot-course!

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: I mean, no! I was selling my wares!

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Sigh... Yes. I asked him to wave a carrot if he heard from someone who'd visited Kali.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why a carrot? There are other things to wave.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: In Eastland, people have apparently waved carrots for secret dealings or discreet checks since long ago.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: So you really went to Kali?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Medea sent a message.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Medea?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You pass along Medea's message for Noel.)

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Hehe. She worries so much. I'm already doing that.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Adventurer, could you do me one favor? You can find Kali and enter directly, so you should be able to help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean? It sounds like you can't enter the village...

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Medea's power protects it. Even a Kali who leaves can't easily find it again. I only learned that after leaving.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: I can't find my way back... And the Land of Illusions is dangerous... But someone special like you can see it clearly.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: At least the Deimos cult hasn't properly located it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. How can I help?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: I have a childhood friend in Kali named Merimel. She's clever with her hands and makes all sorts of things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Merimel! I know her. She's always hard at work.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Same as ever. Hehe. She admires Shynic and wants to build a city like Tartaros. I hope she doesn't copy her personality, too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shh. Shynic's illusions wander everywhere. If she hears that...

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: She finds this sort of thing boring, so it's fine. Anyway, Merimel's been building a machine for ages and still hasn't finished.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: I looked into what she needs. A Dwarven Artisan's Bolts and Nuts should do. They just need to be brought to her...

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: And with a Dwarven Artisan's Universal Toolbox, there'd be nothing she couldn't build! She's full of talent, unlike me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you want me to get those materials and take them to Merimel.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Yes! Exactly! Bring her the materials, and you'll be a VIP of Noel Trading, future great merchant of Tartaros.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Trust is everything to the Kali.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: You can find them in the dwarves' city. I haven't found the courage to go that far yet. Would you go for me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Trust is everything to the Kali... Didn't the spirits talk about trust, too...?)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: You're here again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know outsiders aren't welcome. But someone asked me to bring things you need.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Someone asked...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You give Merimel the Dwarven Artisan's Bolts and Nuts and Universal Toolbox.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Oh, these...

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Noel asked you.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: (Tears begin to fill Merimel's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Noel, Noel... Waaaaah!

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Beinan only ever brings useless things...

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: (In the distance, Beinan looks at Merimel and sighs.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: I miss Noel, but she left and never came back... That awful girl. Doesn't she know how worried I've been?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Noel says even a Kali can't easily find the village again after leaving.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: So that's why she couldn't return. I thought she'd simply left without thinking of me... I had no idea.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: (Merimel's eyes look sorrowful.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: But Beinan goes out to deal with Deimos cult hunters and comes right back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does he?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Well, he's a little different from the other villagers. Things happened when he was young...

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Thanks to this, I should be able to build machines to protect the village. Medea worries and tells me not to overdo it...

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: But I'll work hard within my abilities. For everyone in the village!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The people here care so deeply for one another.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Noel already seems to trust you. She wouldn't ask just anyone for such a favor...

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: There was something I wanted to say, but I've forgotten. I'll tell you if I remember.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Thank you, adventurer. I think I can trust you now, too.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: If you need help later, tell me. I'll do everything I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Merimel. I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Farewell.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: (Merimel gazes at the items Noel arranged for her and sniffles.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: I'm sorry, Noel...

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: And I love you...
